preconditions.description: The number of stations n must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of two-way railways m must be between 1 and 300,000.
The number of incidents q must be between 0 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w_i <= 10**9 for w_i in w)
preconditions.description: Each cost w_i for constructing a one-way railway must be a positive integer between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 1 <= d <= 10**9 for u, v, d in railways)
preconditions.description: Each railway must connect two different stations with a positive integer length d.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k_i <= n and 1 <= x_i <= 400000000 for k_i, x_i in incidents)
preconditions.description: Each incident must specify a valid station k_i and a positive integer cost increase x_i.

postconditions.description: The output must contain q + 1 lines, each representing the minimal cost after each incident.
Each line of output must be a non-negative integer representing the minimal cost.
The first line of output must represent the minimal cost before any incidents occur.
